text:
neha rao: Heads-up — want to sync on a 'dep-switch' playbook for model catalog migrations. Customer asks are piling up and I think we need a tighter launch gate matrix. TL;DR: propose a 3-tier gate (bench, canary, SLA opt-in) + a pin/TTL policy. Thoughts?

sam kim: +1 for gates. can we make the bench requirement more workload-specific? some customers only care about embed stability not chat.

neha rao: yes — propose bench slices per workload (chat, generation, embeddings). each slice gets pass/fail and an allowed drift % + representative prompt set.

maya li: we should also add "hardware bucket" constraints — some models degrade on T4 vs A10. bench results need device labels.

jonas peterson: runtime concerns: KV cache compatibility is often the silent breaker. If a model variant changes KV layout, lots of cache hits become misses. can we require a compatibility smoke test in the canary lane?

sam kim: +1. canary lane should include a short-running KV cache regression with a small traffic split. automate rollback if error rate > 1% or latency P95 regresses > 20%.

leah ortiz: Actionable asks from customers: 1) a pinned version option for 90 days; 2) migration credits if we force a swap within 30 days; 3) visibility into per-route latency delta. We can negotiate but need clear thresholds.

neha rao: For pin TTLs — propose default 30d with enterprise option 90d. pin request flow: customer submits ticket -> we run compatibility checks (bench + kv smoke + infra fit) -> business approves -> schedule migration window.

maya li: For benchmarks, suggest we store canonical prompt sets + golden outputs and compute: avg quality score, embed cosine drift, hallucination rate (QA eval). keep metadata: model version, quant config, hardware.

ops-bot: CI: compatibility-smoke (A10, T4) — latest run: pass on A10, fail on T4 for kv-smoke. Log: https://ci.redwood/5678

jonas peterson: that CI failure is exactly the point. we need to gate onboarding when hardware mismatch risk exists, or provide a compat shim. Otherwise customers on T4 will break.

sam kim: suggestion: introduce a "hardware risk" label in catalog entries (low/medium/high). high => require explicit hw opt-in during rollout.

neha rao: Good. Draft launch gates we discussed:
- Bench: workload slices + device-aware results, pass/fail and drift thresholds
- Canary: traffic split (0.5–5%), KV smoke, latency/err rollback thresholds
- SLA opt-in: for customers wanting pinned versions + 24/7 support, require 90d pin & migration credits negotiated

leah ortiz: Who owns what?
- Bench harness & prompt sets: maya
- Canary infra & rollback automation: jonas
- Catalog pin policy + customer comms: leah/neha

maya li: fine with benches, will set up initial slices by EOW. need sample prompts from growth & CS.

jonas peterson: can start on canary infra next sprint. will prototype traffic-split automation and KV smoke runner.

leah ortiz: I'll draft the customer-facing matrix and churn the negotiation doc. want a first cut by next Wed.

neha rao: OK — meeting to finalize: Thu 11am. agenda: finalize thresholds, pin TTL options, migration credits formula. please bring one exemplar customer case if you have one.

sam kim: I'll bring the embed-only customer case (big one on APAC infra).

maya li: sending prompt request to #customer-success now. :mailbox_with_mail:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Calendar invite created for Thu 11am.

leah ortiz: quick question — for migration credits, propose a simple formula: credits = max(100, 0.05 * monthly bill) capped at 10k. ok?

neha rao: sounds reasonable as a starting point. we'll sanity-check with finance.

sam kim: minor nit — include a fallback model variant in the rollout plan (quantized vs fp16) for graceful degradation.

jonnas peterson: (typo) jonas: yes, fallback variants are useful; catalog should expose compatible variants list.

neha rao: noted. I'll add to the doc: `compatible_variants` field + `hardware_risk` tag.

leah ortiz: cool. meeting doc link (working): https://docs.redwood/sops/depswitch-playbook-draft

neha rao: thanks all. I'll update the roadmap ticket and tag owners. Short thread — ping if blockers pop up. :thumbsup:
